audit.whatIsWrong: The chart sides are right (Skill / Jax / Ambessa / Jax / Ambessa / Ambessa / Jax, matching the packet and the mirror), but every phases[N].why was untouched boilerplate arguing nothing, and four rows sat at a flat 5/10 regardless of who owns them.
audit.why: The content layer already explains each stage correctly; the full layer's stage reasons did not match the side printed next to them.
audit.corrected: Each stage reason now argues its own side: L1 even on one ability, L2-L3 the Q-Empower burst versus her no-auto chip, L4-5 Jax's ranked combo, L6 Public Execution, first item her energy all-in, two items Jax's extended duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might'.
audit.why: The mirror audit found the same error in three fields and corrected it; the content layer already uses Grandmaster at Arms.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (R, 110s at rank 1). Ambessa's defining spike is Public Execution at 130s rank 1 — she ults on a longer cooldown than Jax, which is the whole reason the all-in race is winnable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Repeating Dashes' — it appears in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, the cooldown block, both do's and the interactions report. Ambessa has no such ability. Separately, nothing anywhere states that Repudiation grounds.
audit.why: Her passive is Drakehound's Step; the threat the page should be tracking is Public Execution. And Repudiation (W, 18s at rank 1) carries the grounding flag, which turns off both of Jax's dashes — Leap Strike and Empower are flagged dashes in his own kit. That is the single most decisive untold interaction in this lane.
audit.corrected: Track Public Execution (130s at rank 1): it blinks 1250 units behind you and suppresses, and suppression is not a basic attack so Counter Strike cannot dodge it. Repudiation grounds you while it braces — inside it Leap Strike and Empower are dead and E is your only out, and it shields, so dumping your burst into the brace makes her slam hit harder.
sources: enemyKit W flags grounding/shield, R flags grounding/hardCC

audit.whatIsWrong: The three flagged suspectNames are false positives.
audit.why: 'Cunning Sweep's', 'Land Public Execution' and 'Relentless Assault's' are all real names with a possessive or verb attached. The detector again missed the actual fabrication, 'Repeating Dashes', sitting in the full layer.

notes: The full layer was tracking a champion ability that does not exist — 'Repeating Dashes' — across eight fields. All replaced with Public Execution and Repudiation. Chart sides were already correct and are left alone; only the flat 5/10 ratings on four rows were adjusted, no sides moved, so no full/content pairing was needed. Biggest gain: Repudiation's grounding shuts off Leap Strike AND Empower (both dash-flagged in Jax's kit) and was stated nowhere on the page.
